Text:
Perkembangan politik Johor kini mula memasuki zon paling panas apabila timbul dakwaan wujud gerakan sulit melibatkan PAS dan UMNO menjelang Pilihan Raya Negeri (PRN) akan datang. 

Desas-desus itu semakin kuat diperkatakan selepas tersebar maklumat bahawa PAS Johor dikatakan bersedia memberi laluan penuh kepada UMNO untuk bertanding tanpa gangguan di banyak kerusi DUN. 

Jika benar berlaku, langkah ini boleh menjadi antara kejutan politik terbesar yang pernah menggegarkan Johor sejak era Muafakat Nasional.

Apa yang lebih mengejutkan, sumber dalaman mendakwa PAS tidak bercadang meletakkan calon secara besar-besaran dalam PRN kali ini, sebaliknya memilih pendekatan memberi ruang kepada UMNO berdepan Pakatan Harapan (PH). 

Difahamkan juga beberapa siri pertemuan tertutup antara pimpinan PAS dan UMNO negeri sudah mula diatur bagi memperincikan bentuk persefahaman politik tersebut. 

Situasi itu sekali gus menimbulkan tanda tanya besar dalam kalangan penyokong Perikatan Nasional (PN) mengenai hala tuju sebenar gabungan pembangkang di Johor.

Dalam masa sama, timbul pula dakwaan bahawa PAS bakal menerima “ganjaran politik” sekiranya Barisan Nasional (BN) berjaya mengekalkan kuasa di Johor. 

Antara perkara yang mula hangat diperkatakan ialah kemungkinan beberapa pemimpin PAS diberikan laluan sebagai ADUN lantikan bagi memastikan parti itu terus mempunyai pengaruh dalam pentadbiran negeri walaupun tidak bertanding secara langsung. 

Langkah tersebut dilihat sebagai strategi politik baharu yang mampu mengubah keseluruhan peta kuasa Melayu di Johor.

Ramai pemerhati politik melihat perkembangan ini sebagai permulaan kepada penjajaran politik baharu yang jauh lebih agresif dan luar biasa. 

Johor kini dilihat bukan lagi sekadar medan pertembungan PH, BN dan PN, tetapi bakal menjadi lokasi ujian kepada kerjasama politik paling sensasi menjelang PRN. 

Jika dakwaan ini benar-benar menjadi kenyataan, ia bukan sahaja mampu menggoncang gabungan pembangkang, malah boleh mencetuskan gelombang baharu yang mengubah landskap politik Johor secara keseluruhan.

Text:
Pilihan Raya Negeri (PRN) Johor semakin menghampiri dan perbincangan mengenai pembahagian kerusi antara parti-parti dalam Kerajaan Perpaduan mula menjadi perhatian ramai.

Menurut Liew Chin Tong, terdapat kecenderungan dalam kalangan pemimpin UMNO Johor yang mahu bertanding lebih banyak kerusi dan tidak begitu berminat untuk berkongsi kawasan dengan rakan-rakan parti lain.

Beliau mendakwa ada pihak dalam UMNO Johor yang melihat PRN kali ini sebagai peluang terbaik untuk mengukuhkan pengaruh politik mereka di negeri tersebut.

Malah, Chin Tong berpendapat strategi itu bukan sekadar untuk menguasai Johor, tetapi juga sebagai langkah jangka panjang bagi memperkukuhkan kedudukan UMNO dalam politik nasional.

Katanya, Johor selama ini dianggap kubu tradisi UMNO dan kemenangan besar di negeri itu boleh memberi impak besar kepada landskap politik negara.

Namun begitu, beliau mengingatkan bahawa Kerajaan Perpaduan dibentuk atas semangat kerjasama antara pelbagai parti dan bukannya persaingan sesama sendiri.

Menurut beliau, jika setiap parti terlalu fokus kepada kepentingan masing-masing, ia boleh menjejaskan perpaduan yang sedang dibina dalam gabungan kerajaan hari ini.

Chin Tong turut menegaskan bahawa pengagihan kerusi sepatutnya dibuat berdasarkan kekuatan sebenar setiap parti serta peluang terbaik untuk mengekalkan kemenangan.

Beliau berpandangan bahawa pendekatan menang-menang lebih penting berbanding usaha mana-mana parti untuk mendominasi rakan gabungan yang lain.

Ketika spekulasi mengenai pembahagian kerusi terus hangat diperkatakan, rakyat kini menunggu bagaimana rundingan antara parti-parti dalam Kerajaan Perpaduan akan diselesaikan menjelang PRN Johor yang bakal menjadi medan ujian penting buat semua pihak.
Elok pun UMNO Johor pergi Solo. Harap pengundi di Johor kuburkan DAP/PH di PRU 16.Macam si Sabah.

Text:
Undi UMNO-BN di Johor dapat DAP-PH? Betul ke?

Langsung tak betul. 

UMNO-BN adalah asal dan ori di Johor dan tidak pernah benarkan DAP-PH menyertai kerajaan negeri sejak BN menang PRN Johor 2022, walaupun berkali-kali didesak dan dipujuk oleh Madani.

Kalau sejak 2022 pun BN Johor tidak setuju, kenapa pula mereka akan setuju sekiranya berjaya mempertahankan Johor dalam PRN yang akan datang?

Jadi jangan mudah termakan propaganda bahawa undi BN Johor kononnya bermaksud DAP-PH akan masuk kerajaan negeri.

Hakikatnya, BN Johor sudah buktikan pendirian mereka selama ini.

Beri lah sokongan padu kepada Menteri Besar Onn Hafiz Ghazi dan BN Johor untuk teruskan prestasi amat baik mereka demi masa depan, kestabilan dan kemajuan Johor.

Jika PAS masuk bertanding di kawasan 'kubu UMNO' dan berlaku 3 penjuru atau lebih, ada beberapa kemungkinan;

Adapun jika PAS dan UMNO jayakan Muafakat Nasional, ia satu formula paling mujarab untuk pilihanraya dan kebaikan agama, bangsa dan tanah air.

Tindakan kerajaan yang mencarik sensitiviti rakyat teramai terus berlaku serta keputusan dan dasar yang bersifat eksklusif kepada kelompok tertentu terus berbangkit.

Titik mula Muafakat Nasional di Johor adalah sinar  kesejahteraan Malaysia untuk hari mendatang.

Text:
PAS BERI BAYANGAN KERJASAMA MENJELANG PRN JOHOR

PAS memberi bayangan kesediaan meneroka formula kerjasama politik yang lebih luas menjelang PRN Johor.

Presiden PAS,  mengesahkan wujud pertemuan antara pimpinan PAS dan UMNO, namun menyifatkannya sebagai pertemuan biasa.

PAS tetap berpegang kepada agenda penyatuan Melayu-Islam tanpa mengetepikan masyarakat bukan Islam.

Keputusan berkaitan strategi pilihan raya, pembahagian kerusi dan penggunaan logo akan diputuskan selepas taklimat khas PAS Johor pada Isnin depan.

PAS mengesahkan hasrat untuk bertanding dalam PRN Johor, namun jumlah kerusi masih belum dimuktamadkan.

Parti itu tidak semestinya akan bertanding di semua kerusi DUN dan akan menilai faktor pengaruh, peluang kemenangan serta kekuatan calon.

PAS turut terbuka bekerjasama dengan NGO Islam dan tokoh berpengaruh masyarakat bagi memperkukuhkan agenda penyatuan.

Cadangan menghidupkan semula Muafakat Nasional 2.0 dilihat sebagai usaha memperkukuh kekuatan politik Melayu-Islam dan Bumiputera menjelang beberapa PRN akan datang.

"Kita akan bertanding, tetapi segala keputusan akan dibuat berdasarkan pengaruh, peluang kemenangan dan strategi terbaik." – Tan Sri Dato' Seri Tuan Guru Haji Abdul Hadi Awang

Desas-desus mengenai pertemuan sulit antara Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim dan Presiden UMNO Ahmad Zahid Hamidi kini semakin kuat diperkatakan menjelang Pilihan Raya Negeri (PRN) Johor. 

Perbincangan itu dipercayai bertujuan mencari formula baharu kerjasama antara Pakatan Harapan (PH) dan Barisan Nasional (BN) bagi menghadapi gelombang politik yang semakin tidak menentu di negeri tersebut. 

Situasi itu sekali gus mencetuskan tanda tanya besar dalam kalangan penyokong kedua-dua gabungan yang sebelum ini saling menyerang secara terbuka.

Menurut maklumat diperoleh AM Daily, rundingan berprofil tinggi itu dijangka berlangsung dalam masa terdekat sebelum Dewan Undangan Negeri (DUN) Johor dibubarkan secara rasmi. 

Difahamkan, beberapa saluran komunikasi antara pimpinan tertinggi kedua-dua blok sudah mula dibuka bagi meredakan ketegangan politik yang tercetus sejak isu pembahagian kerusi dan pengumuman mahu bertanding solo sebelum ini. 

Ramai melihat langkah tersebut sebagai usaha menyelamatkan kedudukan kerajaan perpaduan daripada terus retak di peringkat negeri dan nasional.

Menariknya, perang mulut antara pemimpin PH dan BN yang sebelum ini begitu panas dilihat mula perlahan secara tiba-tiba. Serangan terbuka, sindiran keras dan tuduhan sesama sendiri kini seakan ‘disejukkan’ bagi memberi ruang kepada rundingan politik yang lebih besar. 

Keadaan itu membuatkan ramai pemerhati politik percaya bahawa kedua-dua pihak sebenarnya sedar pertembungan sesama sendiri hanya akan membuka ruang besar kepada Perikatan Nasional (PN) untuk meraih keuntungan politik di Johor.

Namun di peringkat akar umbi, situasi ini mula mencetuskan kekeliruan dan keresahan dalam kalangan ahli parti serta jentera kempen. Ramai dikatakan semakin pening dengan arah gerak politik semasa kerana sebelum ini diminta menyerang lawan, tetapi kini perlu bersedia untuk kemungkinan duduk semeja semula. 

Dalam masa sama, ramai penyokong PH mula melihat gabungan dengan BN bakal memberi kelebihan besar kepada UMNO kerana faktor rekod kemenangan kerusi lalu di Johor, sekali gus memaksa PH mengorbankan lebih banyak kawasan demi memastikan kerjasama itu dapat diteruskan.

How did The Masters Apprentices get their name?

Jim Keays explained it best in his autobiography His Master's Voice:

“...seemingly out of nowhere, Mick suggested Masters Apprentices, explaining we were apprentices to the masters of blues – Chuck Berry, Bo Diddley, Jimmy Reed, Elmore James, Robert Johnson, among others.”

Jim later reflected:

“It was very much Mick’s band, he was the leader... we accepted his suggestion and in later years I thought it was an inspired choice.”

More than 60 years later, that inspired choice remains one of the most recognisable names in Australian rock history.

🫣‼️One challenge I face every month is creating a table with genuinely diverse opinions. It would be much easier if I simply gathered 12 people who already agreed with each other for June’s discussion on abortion.

But I do not want a homogenized table. That’s the challenge and beauty of trying to build authentic community.

So I’m trying something a little different.

If you RSVP, it would actually help to know your perspective via DM. If too many people land on one side of the discussion, I may save seats to help balance the table. Maybe you’re strongly pro-life, strongly pro-choice, somewhere in the middle, conflicted, or honestly undecided. All of that matters.

Right now, there are already people RSVP’d from different camps of thought, but I’m especially looking to balance the scale with more pro-choice voices, mixed views, and undecided perspectives.

If that’s you, and you’d enjoy a free drink, some food, and a safe place for honest discussion, send me an RSVP.

No shouting matches.
No humiliation.
No pressure.
Just real people having a real conversation about something that deeply impacts human lives.

Ohhh… and one more thing 👀

For July’s Table Talk, I’ll have a videographer capturing parts of the evening to help model something our culture desperately needs right now: how to have meaningful conversations with people we disagree with. 😮😮

You might actually help teach people across the country what respectful discourse can look like.

There's an AI system that watches every car, bike, and pedestrian approaching an intersection in real time… and lines up the lights so you cruise right through. There's a city in Tennessee where AI flagged so many near-crashes on one block that planners made a single change… and the result still blows my mind. When I saw how much safer AI made bike lanes in Vancouver, Canada, I thought maybe I was the one hallucinating. The catch? For any of this to work, the city has to see you. Cameras, radar, the phone in your pocket, the car in your driveway. It kinda creeps me out. So what do we actually get back? And is there a way to get all of this without cameras watching our every move?

Heat pump water heaters have been around for over a decade. If you follow this channel, you probably know they're three to five times more efficient than a standard electric tank. Maybe you've got one. I do. But here's what most people don't realize. Even if you own a heat pump water heater, it's still pretty dumb. It heats reactively. The tank drops below the setpoint, the compressor kicks on. It doesn't know your schedule. It doesn't know your electricity rates. And it definitely doesn't know when your solar panels are cranking. Two Boston startups think that's a massive missed opportunity. They're treating the water heater as a thermal battery, a cheap, insulated vessel that can store energy as heat, shift electricity use to cheaper hours, and participate in grid services. One of them, Wilmington, Massachusetts-based Cala Systems, invited me to tour their factory. Their predictive software is licensed from the National Renewable Energy Lab. According to a California Energy Commission study, intelligent scheduling on time-of-use rate plans alone can cut costs by 15 to 19 percent beyond what a standard heat pump water heater already saves. So I went inside to find out: is a smart water heater actually worth the premium? Or is "intelligent" just a buzzword bumper sticker slapped on a tank of hot water?

I was a teenager on a cruise when I first saw ocean pollution up close. Late at night, I saw crew dumping garbage into the ocean. A stream of trash stretching off toward the horizon. But that garbage spilling into the ocean was just the tip of the trashberg. And that trashberg… is mainly plastic. Plastic makes up about 80 percent of marine pollution. And it doesn't always come from where you'd expect. Most people think of waste plastic as straws, bottles, and grocery bags washing off beaches. But when a Dutch nonprofit called The Ocean Cleanup sailed out to the Great Pacific Garbage Patch to scoop it all up… they found something else entirely. More than three-quarters of the plastic wasn’t consumer trash... at all. It didn’t even come from the shore! Even worse, cleaning it up was a lot harder than anyone hoped. So, they did something surprising. They turned around, returned to shore, and started tackling the plastic problem upstream. This is the story of what The Ocean Cleanup discovered once they started studying the problem up close… and why solving ocean plastic might mean turning off the tap, and not just mopping up what's already spilled.

What engineers call a "black start," a process that could take days to weeks to recover from. Not to mention all of the people that died as a result. According to the Department of Energy, 70 percent of US transmission lines are over 25 years old. We're running 21st century lives on a mid-20th century grid. But back in 1997, energy consultant Karl Rábago wrote a blueprint for a radically different grid. His model? The internet. Seriously. And no, I'm not talking about today's internet, which is just five billionaires in a trench coat. I'm talking about the '90s internet. Decentralized. Collaborative. And really, really cool. So how would the internet stop a blackout? And why did the guy who figured it out get ignored for 30 years? But first, we need to understand what went so wrong.

👉 “Undecided” = Instant Rejection at Top Schools?

❌ Nope. Big myth.

👉 In many top U.S. & European universities, students are allowed to enter without choosing a major for the first 1–2 years.

✨ That’s called Undecided / Undeclared.

💡 What “Undecided” REALLY means
• You’re exploring before locking in a lifelong path
• You’re taking general courses and discovering your strengths
• You’re using a flexible education system (not wasting time)

📊 Fun fact:
🔹 20–50% of U.S. students start Undecided
🔹 ~75% change their major at least once anyway

😰 Common fears (and the truth)
❌ “Undecided students get rejected more” → False
❌ “Top universities don’t like it” → False
❌ “It means no goals” → False

✅ Universities care more about:
• Curiosity
• Academic effort
• Growth mindset
—not whether you picked a major at 17.

⚠️ When Undecided may NOT be ideal
• Highly competitive majors (Engineering, Business, Nursing)
• Schools that require major selection from Year 1

👉 In these cases:
Apply with a major → transfer internally later

🎯 Smart strategy
✔️ Ivy League / Liberal Arts schools → Undecided is OK
✔️ STEM-heavy schools → Choose a clear major
✔️ Essays matter more than the label

✨ Not knowing your major yet ≠ not knowing your future.
Exploration is a strength—when done strategically.

What if every piece of plastic waste, like bottles, bags, even clothes, could be rebuilt from scratch, no sorting required? Not just melted and reshaped, but broken down to pure chemical building blocks and made new again. That's what a new wave of recycling tech promises. Northwestern University has built a catalyst that can zero in on a single type of plastic in mixed waste and break it down. No sorting, no problem. In South Korea, a 2,000°C hydrogen plasma torch is cracking mixed plastics in milliseconds, turning them into valuable building blocks for brand-new plastics. And in France, an enzymatic recycling plant is transforming previously unrecyclable polyester textiles back into virgin-quality plastic feedstock. We've been sold the recycling dream for decades, but the reality? Most plastic still ends up in landfills or the ocean. Could these breakthroughs finally turn recycling from marketing lie into working reality?
